disposition_reason: Total arsenic is reported per tissue for clam, short-necked clam, oyster, arkshell and scallop purchased live from a retail supplier.

study.design: tissue distribution of total arsenic and arsenic speciation in gills of five bivalve species
study.market: live specimens purchased from a retail supplier (Japan; authors in Tokyo)
study.method: HNO3/HClO4/H2SO4 wet digestion; total As by ICP emission spectrometry (Jarrell Ash Atom Comp 800); gill water-soluble arsenic fractionated on Dowex 50 and analysed by HPLC-ICP

findings.group: experiment 1, live specimens from a retail supplier, Japan
findings.notes: pooled tissue from at least 8 specimens; total arsenic by ICP emission spectrometry after HNO3/HClO4/H2SO4 digestion; wet weight basis

Whole edible soft-tissue values are not printed; only per-tissue values.
